description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Forms' class which is a module for handling form-related elements in HTML purifiers. It sets up various form elements like form, input, select, option, textarea, button, fieldset, label, legend, and optgroup with their respective attributes and behaviors.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Forms
classes.description: A module for defining form-related elements and attributes in the HTML purifier.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes form elements and their attributes within the module based on provided configuration.
